item.title: Nepal flash flood deaths exceed 600, with about 3,000 missing
item.description: A Nepali Army spokesperson said early Saturday that helicopter operations were paused until weather conditions improved.

item.title: Russian strike on Ukrainian warehouse kills 27, prompts ammunition storage probe
item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy suggested the warehouse near a residential area hit by a Russian strike was used to store ammunition.

item.title: Judge dismisses confession of alleged 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed
item.description: The ruling is a setback for the federal government's long-delayed prosecution of Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, accused of developing the plot to attack the U.S.

item.title: Iran pledges resistance to U.S. sanctions as conflict reaches six months
item.description: As the war passes the six-month mark, neither side shows signs of backing down.
